reference: Hastie, Tibshirani & Friedman (2009), The Elements of Statistical Learning, 2nd ed., corrected 12th printing (2017).

short_quotes.text: Model selection: estimating the performance of different models in order to choose the best one.
In general, with a multistep modeling procedure, cross-validation must be applied to the entire sequence of modeling steps.

use: Squared error; separate fitting, selection and assessment; refit for each held-out fold; resampling is diagnostic.
limits: Does not prescribe our six-item criterion, minimax interval loss, task-group split or specific weights. Three task groups do not establish generalisation.
